strings.requirement.uk_recent_unmodified: Taken within the last month. The issuing authority does not permit software changes.
strings.requirement.uk_print_professional_unmodi: Provide 2 identical professional-standard prints; software changes are not permitted.
strings.requirement.us_print_only_photo_tool: The 600 x 600 px Photo Tool output is only for printing and mail or in-person applications, not online passport renewal.
strings.requirement.canada_digital_original: A commercial photographer must provide the original camera file. Scans of printed photos and all edits are prohibited.
strings.requirement.canada_print_professional: Must be taken by a commercial photographer and printed on professional photographic paper; cropping, background replacement, AI, filters and other edits are prohibited.
strings.requirement.korea_no_background_edit: Cropping and resizing preserve the original background. AI, filters, background removal and compositing are prohibited.
strings.requirement.singapore_resize_only: 400 x 514 px is the recommended e-Service size. Resizing is allowed, but the photo and facial features must not be altered or enhanced.
strings.requirement.australia_limited_adjustment: Keep the original light plain background. Do not retouch or replace the background; official guidance only permits limited brightness or contrast adjustment.
strings.requirement.hk_camera_minimum: For a digital-camera upload, JPEG must be at least 1200 x 1600 px and no more than 5 MB. Final acceptance is determined by Immigration Department review.
strings.requirement.hk_print_original_quality: Use a 40 x 50 mm recent colour photo on a plain white background. Do not fold, staple, write on or paper-clip the print.
strings.requirement.france_authorized_no_white: The photo must be taken by a qualified professional or in an approved booth. Use a light plain background; white is prohibited.
strings.requirement.cn_reported_composition: Reported official guidance: 33 x 48 mm. Head height is commonly reported as about 28-33 mm; top margin is intentionally not treated as a fixed official limit because secondary sources conflict.
strings.requirement.jp_reported_composition: Reported official guidance: 35 x 45 mm, head height about 32-36 mm and top margin about 2-6 mm. The original official page was not directly verified.
strings.requirement.de_official_composition: German Federal Foreign Office PDF: 35 x 45 mm with a head height of about 32-36 mm. No fixed top-margin value is encoded; verify the generated result against the official examples.
strings.requirement.schengen_reported_compositio: Reported official guidance: 35 x 45 mm with head height about 32-36 mm. The receiving consulate or visa centre may apply additional rules.
strings.requirement.in_reported_composition: Reported guidance: 35 x 45 mm for this catalogue preset. Indian missions and application channels may request a different format; verify before submission.
strings.requirement.nz_reported_composition: Reported official guidance: 35 x 45 mm; secondary guidance commonly reports at least 900 x 1200 px for digital photos. The official page was not directly verified, so head placement remains a soft reference.
strings.requirement.my_reported_composition: Reported guidance: 35 x 50 mm. Head placement is treated as a soft reference because the official page was not directly verified.
strings.requirement.th_reported_composition: Reported guidance: 35 x 45 mm, head height about 34 mm and top margin about 3 mm. The official page was not directly verified.
strings.requirement.vn_reported_composition: Reported guidance: 40 x 60 mm with head height about 39 mm. Requirements can vary by application channel, so this remains a soft reference.
strings.requirement.id_reported_composition: Reported guidance: 40 x 60 mm. Head placement is treated as a soft reference because the official page was not directly verified.
strings.requirement.ae_reported_composition: Reported official guidance: 40 x 60 mm with head height about 38 mm. The official page was not directly verified, so head placement remains a soft reference and the receiving channel must be checked.
strings.requirement.tw_reported_composition: Reported official guidance: 35 x 45 mm. Head placement is treated as a soft reference because the official page was not directly verified.
